_readme: FIAT ITEMS, THE COUNTY (6 Nov; docs/design/county_stages.md §4-5): the 24 new bases' pictures, 24 jobs, all at $0.08 (every canvas under 65k px; about $1.92).

The item template of make_items29_manifest.py, straight to the live name art/items/<slug>.png. They show once the 24 ART_AS entries for these bases come off (data.gd; Items.art_name reads ART_AS first) - the wiring step. ++ --parallel 3.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_items_county_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.
